verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents core interactive-history-rewrite actions: Delete Commit, Edit Message, Squash with child commit, Amend latest commit, and Undo unpushed commits (docs-15, docs-16, docs-17). This covers the main story elements but lacks evidence of arbitrary reordering of multiple commits or a full interactive rebase UI spanning more than adjacent commits. Missing for 10: documented support for reordering non-adjacent commits or a multi-commit interactive rebase view, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
